chief_complaint: Post‑myocardial infarction and diabetes management with high cardiovascular risk
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 77‑year‑old woman with a recent (January 2023) myocardial infarction (now resolved) who is being followed for type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome, obesity, hypertriglyceridemia, hypertension (treated with losartan) and dyslipidemia. Over the past two years she has had multiple wellness visits and serial retinal photography for diabetic eye screening. She reports ongoing stress, social isolation, limited social contact and a history of intimate partner abuse. Diabetic neuropathy is present and she receives vitamin B12 injections. Polypharmacy includes dual statin therapy, low‑dose carvedilol, aspirin and losartan. Laboratory and vital‑sign data (blood pressure, lipid panel, renal function) are missing, limiting assessment of disease control.

active_problems.name: Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
